integrity: A complete analytic argument gives the area and perimeter formulas, reduces all moments to a weighted complete elliptic integral, and proves strict positivity by rational interval bounds for its hypergeometric series. Numerical hull sampling serves as independent geometric testing, not as proof. The weighted elliptic integral itself occurs in an earlier cube-shadow calculation and is not claimed novel.
scientific_limitations: Right circular solid cylinders in three-dimensional Euclidean space; Haar-random planar shadows only. No generalization to oblique cylinders, zonoids or arbitrary bodies. An equivalent historical computation may exist outside the inspected sources.
title: Exact cylinder shadow mixed moment and sharp positive covariance
